title: Experimental and Theoretical Examination of DNA-Binding Properties of Ruthenium(II)-Hydrazine Complexes.
authors: Dimic, Dusan; Rakic, Aleksandra; Stojanovic, Katarina; Kaluderovic, Goran N; Markovic, Jasmina Dimitric; Milenkovic, Dejan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过荧光光谱、分子对接和ONIOM QM/MM模拟研究钌配合物与DNA的小沟结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系外的金属配合物-DNA结合，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非蛋白-DNA且无TF特异性。
abstract: The DNA-binding properties of four Ru(II)-hydrazine complexes [RuCl(eta(6)-p-cymene)(2)(mu-Cl)(mu-L(1)-kappa(2)N,N')]Cl (1, L(1): 3,4-dimethylphenylhydrazine) and [RuCl(2)(eta(6)-p-cymene)(L(1-3)-kappaN)] complexes (2, L(1); 3, L3: 3-chlorophenylhydrazine; 4, L(3): 3-nitrophenylhydrazine) were explored through a combination of fluorescence spectroscopy, molecular docking, and Our own N-layered Integrated molecular Orbital and Molecular Mechanic (ONIOM)-based quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations. Ethidium bromide (EtBr) displacement assays revealed that all compounds interact with DNA, with calculated quenching constants (K(SV)) ranging from 2.44 to 4.79 x 10(4 )M. The results led to the conclusion that all complexes interact with DNA with similar strength, although subtle differences were explained by the present structural groups and molecular electrostatic potential (MEP) maps. The presence of nitro and chloro substituents was important for the weak interactions with DNA, leading to partial removal of EtBr. Computational studies supported the experimental findings. Molecular docking confirmed minor groove binding for all four complexes, with favorable interaction geometries and binding energies. Complex 3 stood out, with the most negative docking score (DeltaG(bind) = -38.2 kJ mol(-1)). The docking simulations with RNA, triplex DNA/RNA, and quadruplex DNA/RNA additionally proved that the size of the complex and the presence of substituents were determinants of selectivity. Further refinement using ONIOM-based QM/MM calculations yielded interaction energies with DNA that matched previous results, identifying compound 3 as the most stable DNA-binding species (DeltaE = -532.7 kJ mol(-1)). The correlation between spectroscopic and theoretical results highlights the role of Ru(II)-hydrazine ligand structure in modulating DNA affinity. Complex 3, bearing electron-donating hydrazine functionality and favorable spatial orientation, emerged as a promising candidate for further development in DNA-targeted therapies.
abstract_zh: 四种Ru(II)-肼配合物[RuCl(eta(6)-p-cymene)(2)(mu-Cl)(mu-L(1)-kappa(2)N,N')]Cl（1，L(1)：3,4-二甲基苯肼）和[RuCl(2)(eta(6)-p-cymene)(L(1-3)-kappaN)]配合物（2，L(1)；3，L3：3-氯苯肼；4，L(3)：3-硝基苯肼）的DNA结合性质，通过荧光光谱、分子对接以及基于我们自有的N层集成分子轨道和分子力学（ONIOM）的量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）模拟相结合的方法进行了探索。溴化乙锭（EtBr）置换实验表明，所有化合物均与DNA相互作用，计算得到的淬灭常数（K(SV)）范围为2.44至4.79 x 10(4) M。结果得出结论，所有配合物以相似强度与DNA相互作用，尽管细微差异由存在的结构基团和分子静电势（MEP）图谱解释。硝基和氯取代基的存在对与DNA的弱相互作用至关重要，导致EtBr的部分去除。计算研究支持了实验发现。分子对接确认了所有四种配合物的次要沟槽结合，具有有利的相互作用几何构型和结合能。配合物3表现突出，具有最负的对接分数（DeltaG(bind) = -38.2 kJ mol(-1)）。与RNA、三链DNA/RNA和四链DNA/RNA的对接模拟进一步证明，配合物的大小和取代基的存在是选择性的决定因素。使用基于ONIOM的QM/MM计算进一步细化，得到与DNA的相互作用能，与先前结果匹配，确定化合物3为最稳定的DNA结合物种（DeltaE = -532.7 kJ mol(-1)）。光谱与理论结果之间的相关性强调了Ru(II)-肼配体结构在调节DNA亲和力中的作用。配合物3，带有供电子肼官能团和有利的空间取向，成为DNA靶向治疗进一步发展的有前景候选物。
